identity: The Arabic Wikipedia article on the robot (al-rubut / al-insan al-ali / al-insala): the naming and definition, the origin of the word in Capeks 1920 play R.U.R., a section heading, the scholarly dispute over what counts as a robot, the science of robotics, industrial robots, and self-directing robots. Six printed lines - five prose paragraphs and one heading line.
law: ENCYCLOPEDIC PROSE (section A), EDITED. Median line 115 tokens, so PASS 0 gives nothing and PASS 2 does all the work. This is the register where batch-12s 1j applies at full strength: a COORDINATOR heading a new finite clause (w + verb, f + verb, wa-qad) is a boundary, a SUBORDINATOR is not. 603 real tokens / 32 units = 19.0 per unit - at the top of my range, and I pushed it down deliberately after batch 12 showed that over 20 in prose means under-cutting.
reasoning: The paragraph structure is a chain of w-headed statements and I cut at nearly every one that carries a new finite verb or a new nominal predication: @148 wa-mubtakir hadhihi al-kalima, @229 wa-hujjatuhum, @254 wa-yurid haula, @292 wa-yattadih min hadha, @349 wa-ilm al-rubutik, @363 wa-yuraf aydan, @372 wa-yuqsad biha, @400 wa-hiya takun, @432 wa-yustamal al-sawad al-azam, @442 wa-hadhihi al-insalat mubarmaja, @463 wa-qad tammat idafa, @515 wa-laalla abraz, @532 wa-hunaka min al-insalat, @569/@581 the two wa-hadhihi al-insalat, @607 wa-hiya taqum. Against that, every subordinator was refused: idh (@110), alladhi / allati / wa-lladhi throughout, baynama (@223), kama (@424), li-adam (@247), ka-an (@546), wa-an as complementiser (@317), and wa-dhalika as anaphora (@476). Three judgement calls. (1) @173 and @463 both precede al-amr alladhi, the resumptive relative of Arabic journalism; it is formally a relative pronoun and 0p forbids cutting there, but leaving both merged produced 40- and 46-token units, so I cut both - identically, and marked them lo. (2) @503: min-ha introducing a list of examples is H1s announcer, but its items here are w-joined bare NPs inside running prose, so I treated it as a sentence break rather than a colon cut, and I did NOT make the parallel cut at @379 (min-ha ma yustamal), where the min-ha clause is the predicate of the sentence itself. (3) @356 li-arbaat ulum asasiyya HIYA + four sciences is the quantity-announcer of B10, but the four are w-joined (al-riyadiyyat wa-al-handasa wa-al-maalumatiyya wa-akhiran al-ulum), which I5 says is bare coordination, so no colon cut and no cuts between the items. Masdar chains at @37, @219, @252, @412-@419, @480, @588 all merge (0t).
